title: William E. Mason (Canadian politician) - Wikipedia

Introduction
William Ethelbert Mason (1866 – August 24, 1951) was a businessman and
 political figure in Saskatchewan, Canada. He was mayor of Regina from
 1925 to 1926. He was born in Toronto and came to Regina
 in 1905 to open a branch of the Canada Permanent Mortgage Corporation. In 1891, he
 had married Helen Agnes Cockburn. In 1920, he retired from that job and opened the
 W. E. Mason Discount Company. Mason was also head of the Prudential Trust Company.
 He served as Regina's first magistrate. His daughter, who served as a nurse in England during World War I, died of the Spanish flu. ^ "W.
 E. Mason, former Regina mayor, dies". The
 Leader-Post. Regina, Saskatchewan. August 24, 1951.
 p. 5. Retrieved January 15, 2019. ^ Regina Ethnic Pioneers Cemetery
 Walking Tour Inc (2000). Regina
 Cemetery Walking Tour: Tour 1: City Founding Fathers
 (Blue Tour). p. 16. Archived from the
 original on 2016-03-03. Retrieved 2009-08-21.
